JUDGMENT AND ORDER
Justice of the Court:
Tom Montagu – Smith KC
8

JUDGMENT AND ORDER
1. Pursuant to a Claim Form made on 11 February 2026 the Claimant seeks an Order from this Court to
recognise and enforce the measures set forth in part VII. of the IAC Arbitration Award dated
23 January 2026 made by Ms. Snezhana Kutsenko, the sole arbitrator appointed by a letter dated 14
August 2025 of Mr. Thomas Krümmel, the Chairman of the International Arbitration Centre, in IAC
Arbitration Case No. 140/2025.
2. Having read the Award it appears to me that the application is justified. Accordingly, I hereby order:
TOO "JS Almaty" BIN: 201240009887, TOO "Karaoke Group" BIN: 200640030857, Baisarenov
Dzhambul Kurmangazynovich, IIN: 891017351231 and Li Valery Arkadyevich, IIN: 830825000851
are jointly and severally liable to then Claimants for the debt in the amount of: 174,827,917 (one
hundred seventy-four million eight hundred twenty-seven thousand nine hundred seventeen tenge
(USD 340,344.02), expenses for the payment of representative services in the amount of 5,000,000
(five million) tenge (USD 9,733.68), expenses for the payment of the arbitrator's fee in the amount
of 900,000 (nine hundred thousand) tenge (USD 1,752), arbitration fees in the amount of
903,639.59 tenge, expenses paid to the notary for the preparation of powers of attorney in the
amount of 1,572,606 tenge (total amount of expenses 8,376,245.59 (eight million three hundred
seventy-six thousand two hundred forty-five tenge 59 tiyn).
The Claimants are entitled to recover jointly and severally from “JS Almaty” LLP, BIN:
201240009887, “Karaoke Group” LLP, BIN: 200640030857, Baisarenov Dzhambul
Kurmangazynovich IIN: 891017351231 and Li Valery Arkadyevich IIN: 830825000851 debt in the
amount of: 174,827,917 (one hundred and seventy-four million, eight hundred and twenty-seven
thousand, nine hundred and seventeen tenge. (USD 340,344.02), expenses in the amount of
8,376,245.59 (eight million, three hundred and seventy-six thousand, two hundred and forty-five
tenge 59 tiyn).
3. The Defendants are given liberty to apply to have this Order set aside within 14 days of service upon
it of this Order.
4. This Order shall not be enforced (a) until after the end of the period set out in paragraph 3 above or
(b)until after any application made by the Defendant within that period has been finally disposed of,
whichever is the later.
By Order of the Court,
Tom Montagu – Smith KC,
Justice, AIFC Court
Representation:
The Claimants were represented by Daniyar Niyazgulov, director, law firm Benefits & Partners.
The Defendants were not represented.
